a handmade crafts shop. I need:
- Homepage with a hero banner, featured products
  section, and a newsletter signup
- Product catalog page with category filters
  (pottery, textiles, woodwork, jewelry) and a grid
  of product cards with images, names, and prices
- About page with our story, team member profiles
  with photos, and a mission statement
- Shared navigation header and footer across all
  pages
Use React Router for page navigation. Products
should be fetched from an API endpoint.

Let me mark the remaining todos complete:The full site is built and all 5 tasks are complete. Here's what was delivered:

input.prompt:
Build a multi-page artisan crafts website. Full details below.

PROJECT DETAILS:
- Business: Artisan Goods Co. — handmade crafts shop
- Pages: Homepage, Product Catalog, About
- Audience: Craft lovers, gift shoppers, design-conscious consumers
- Tone: Warm, artisanal, trustworthy, community-rooted

DESIGN DIRECTION:
Warm and earthy with an editorial handcrafted feel. Think independent boutique, not mass-market retail. Rich textures implied through color and typography — generous whitespace, natural warmth, and confident type hierarchy that feels hand-selected, not templated.

LAYOUT TYPE: Standard
Multi-page marketing + shop site. Full header with navigation and footer with links across all pages.

VISUAL DIRECTION:
- Color: Warm neutrals — cream/off-white background, warm terracotta or clay as primary accent, deep walnut brown for text. Avoid pure white or cold grays.
- Typography: Serif display font for headings (warmth, craft heritage), clean sans-serif for body and UI. Mix weights confidently — oversized hero headline, tight leading on cards.
- Layout: Full-bleed hero with editorial feel. Product grid uses varied card proportions. NO uniform icon grids anywhere.

VISUAL ELEMENTS:
- Primary: Photography — product shots with natural lighting, warm tones
- Style: Artisanal product photography feel — close-up textures, earthy backgrounds
- Application: Hero full-bleed image, product card images, team photos on About page
- Logo: Wordmark-style logo with a small craft icon (leaf, hand, or loom motif). Use the media-logo skill to generate it. Place in header top-left.

MOTION DESIGN:
- Level: Subtle
- Effects: Fade-in on scroll for product cards (staggered, 300ms), hover lift on product cards (translate-y -4px + shadow), smooth underline draw on nav links, gentle button color fill on hover
- Personality: Warm and unhurried — nothing snappy or corporate

SECTION-SPECIFIC:

Hero (Homepage):
- Full-bleed background image (search for artisan workshop / handmade crafts hero)
- Warm overlay gradient (not pure black — use warm brown/terracotta)
- Large serif headline: "Handcrafted with Care, Made to Last"
- Subtext + two CTAs: "Shop Now" → /products, "Our Story" → /about
- Staggered entrance animation on headline + subtext + CTAs

Featured Products (Homepage):
- Section title: "Featured Pieces"
- 4 product cards pulled from /api/products?featured=true
- Asymmetric bento-style layout (2 large + 2 small cards), NOT a uniform 4-column grid
- Each card: image, category tag, product name, price, hover lift effect

Newsletter Signup (Homepage):
- Warm terracotta band — asymmetric layout (headline left, form right)
- Headline: "Join Our Community"
- Email input + "Subscribe" button
- NOT a centered-text-on-colored-band layout

Product Catalog Page (/products):
- Page title: "Our Collection"
- Category filter tabs: All | Pottery | Textiles | Woodwork | Jewelry
- Filters are client-side — filter the products array by category
- Products fetched from /api/products via route loader
- Responsive grid: 3 columns desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile
- Each card: product image, category badge, name, price, "View Details" hover reveal
- Staggered fade-in on cards when category changes

About Page (/about):
- Hero: Full-width warm image (search for artisan workshop interior)
- Mission statement section: Large serif quote-style text, centered, generous padding
- "Our Story" section: Two-column — text left, image right (asymmetric)
- Team section: 3 team member cards with photo, name, role, short bio
- Search for team member portrait photos (warm, natural lighting)

SHARED HEADER:
- Logo top-left (media-logo skill)
- Nav links: Home | Shop | About
- CTA button: "Shop Now" → /products (terracotta accent)
- Mobile hamburger menu
- Subtle bottom border, warm background matching page

SHARED FOOTER:
- Multi-column: Brand column (logo + tagline), Quick Links, Categories, Newsletter teaser
- Warm dark background (deep walnut/charcoal-brown), light text
- Social icons row
- Copyright line
- Maintain design quality — footer is NOT an afterthought

DIFFERENTIATION:
Bento-style featured products layout on homepage breaks the standard uniform grid. Serif + oversized typography in hero creates editorial, magazine-quality feel.

CONSISTENCY:
Warm earthy palette and serif/sans type pairing must carry through all three pages and the footer. Animation timing consistent (300ms ease-out). Never let the design get safer or more generic as pages progress.

BUILD ORDER:

Phase 1 — Setup (run in parallel):
- Search for images: hero (artisan workshop/handmade crafts), product shots (pottery, textiles, woodwork, jewelry — at least 8 total), team portraits (3), about page interior
- Set font stack using fontTheme tool — serif display + clean sans pairing
- Set color scheme using colorTheme tool — warm cream, terracotta accent, walnut text
- Generate logo using media-logo skill — wordmark "Artisan Goods Co." with small craft motif

Phase 2 — API + Structure (run in parallel after Phase 1):
- Build /api/products Express endpoint in src/server/api/products.ts — returns array of 12 products across 4 categories (pottery, textiles, woodwork, jewelry), each with: id, name, category, price, image (use found image URLs), description, featured (bool). Register in src/server/entry.ts.
- Build Header (src/layouts/parts/Header.tsx) — logo, nav links, CTA, mobile menu
- Build Footer (src/layouts/parts/Footer.tsx) — multi-column warm dark footer

Phase 3 — Pages (after Phase 1 & 2):
- Build Homepage (src/pages/index.tsx) — hero, featured products (fetched via loader from /api/products?featured=true), newsletter signup
- Build Product Catalog (src/pages/products.tsx) — category filters, product grid, fetched via route loader
- Build About page (src/pages/about.tsx) — mission, story, team profiles

Phase 4 — Routes + Finalize:
- Register all routes in src/routes.tsx with loaders for /products and homepage featured products
- Mark all todo items as complete using todoList tool
- Show the design and ask for feedback using askQuestion

CRITICAL: Build pages LAST — after API, header, footer, fonts, and colors are all in place.

TODO LIST IDs (mark complete after each phase):
- Homepage: 1780032633790-708kp9v
- Product catalog page: 1780032633790-dfg4izi
- About page: 1780032633790-kf53rzf
- Shared header & footer: 1780032633791-mhbjvcw
- Products API endpoint: 1780032633791-r7lfnx6

INITIAL SCOPE: Build all three pages + API as described. This is the full initial build.

DESIGN FEEDBACK:
After showing the site, use askQuestion to ask:
- "What do you think of the design?"
- Suggestions: ["Looks great — let's add product detail pages", "Change the color scheme", "Add a shopping cart", "Adjust the typography"]

She designs all the jewelry and oversees the visual identity of the brand — making sure every piece feels cohesive and considered.', image: '/airo-assets/images/team/sofia-okafor-designer', }, ]; export default function AboutPage() { return ( <> Our Story — Artisan Goods Co. {/* ── Hero ── */}
Our Story Made by Hands That Care
{/* ── Mission Statement ── */}
Our Mission "We believe the world is better when things are made slowly, with skill, and with love for the material." Artisan Goods Co. exists to connect makers with people who value what they make. We are not a marketplace. We are a curated community of craftspeople who share a commitment to quality, sustainability, and the slow, deliberate act of making.
{/* ── Our Story — Two Column ── */}
{/* Text — left */}

How It Started

A Garage, a Wheel, and a Big Idea

In 2014, Elena Vasquez set up a pottery wheel in her garage in Portland, Oregon. She wasn't trying to start a business — she was trying to make something real with her hands after years behind a desk.

Friends started asking to buy her bowls. Then friends of friends. Then strangers on the internet. Within two years, she had a waiting list and a problem: she couldn't make enough on her own.

Instead of scaling up production, Elena did something different. She reached out to other makers she admired — woodworkers, weavers, jewelers — and invited them to join her under one roof. Artisan Goods Co. was born.

Today we work with a small, carefully chosen group of makers. Every piece on this site was made by a person, not a machine. We intend to keep it that way.
